Benchmark variant callers against truth or each other

Source: R/validation.R
benchmarkCallers.Rd

If a truth WithinHostExperiment is provided, computes true positives, false positives, false negatives, precision, recall, and F1 for each caller. If no truth is provided, computes pairwise agreement using calcCallerConcordance.

Usage

benchmarkCallers(whe_list, truth = NULL)

Arguments

whe_list

A named list of WithinHostExperiment objects, one per variant caller.

truth

An optional WithinHostExperiment containing the true variant set. Default NULL.

Value

A DataFrame. When truth is provided:

caller

Caller name.

n_total

Total sites called by this caller.

TP

True positives.

FP

False positives.

FN

False negatives.

precision

TP / (TP + FP).

recall

TP / (TP + FN).

F1

Harmonic mean of precision and recall.

When truth is NULL, the result of calcCallerConcordance is returned. A site counts as called, by a caller or in the truth set, when some sample has a frequency above 0 there; a recorded 0 is a site assessed without the allele and is not a call.

Examples

gr1 <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("seg1",
    IRanges::IRanges(c(100, 200, 300), width = 1))
S4Vectors::mcols(gr1)$ref <- c("A", "C", "G")
S4Vectors::mcols(gr1)$alt <- c("T", "G", "A")
whe1 <- WithinHostExperiment(
    assays = list(altFreq = matrix(c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3), ncol = 1)),
    rowRanges = gr1,
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(sample_id = "S1"))
benchmarkCallers(list(caller1 = whe1), truth = whe1)
#> DataFrame with 1 row and 8 columns
#>        caller   n_total        TP        FP        FN precision    recall
#>   <character> <integer> <integer> <integer> <integer> <numeric> <numeric>
#> 1     caller1         3         3         0         0         1         1
#>          F1
#>   <numeric>
#> 1         1
